name: pos-terminal
description: Restaurant POS Terminal — Order management, billing, inventory & kitchen display
author: POS Terminal Team

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix ../backend run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix ../backend run dev" "npm --prefix Frontend run dev" "wait-on --timeout 60000 http://localhost:5175 && cd electron && npx tsc && npx electron . --dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../backend run build && npm --prefix Frontend run build
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx electron-builder --win --config electron/electron-builder.json
scripts.build:electron:dir: npm run build && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npx electron-builder --win --dir --config electron/electron-builder.json
scripts.electron:dev: cd electron && npx tsc 2>&1 && npx electron . --dev
scripts.electron:prod: cd electron && npx tsc && npx electron .
